Emma: Real quick sync on NebulaEdge listing + marketplace launch. Need to lock embargo and SI handoff.
Luis: Marketing proposed Jun 22 public launch 09:00 PT. NebulaEdge team asked for Jun 21 embargo.
Tanya: SI smoke runs are scheduled Jun 20 (full) and Jun 21 (post-embargo partner-only validation). We can't move those.
Comms: Proposal: partner-only embargo Jun 21, public Jun 22 09:00 PT. Final assets due by Jun 5.
LegalBot: Legal needs partner quote release permission and trademark usage approval by Jun 3. Also require data processing blurb for marketplace tile.
SILead: For SI run we need a test SKU and sandbox billing. Can we get SKU mapping and test key by Jun 1?
Luis: I'll ask NebulaEdge for SKU CSV and a short/long quote by May 30.
Emma: Landing content decision: link to marketplace tile for pricing, include "Try on NebulaEdge" CTA. No pricing on page.
DeployBot: Staging deploy OK. URL: https://staging.redwood.ai/marketplace/nebulaedge (build 2026.05.18-2).
Tanya: I'll publish the SI runbook by Jun 10 and request staging credentials by Jun 12.
Comms: Press targets: TechCrunch, InfoQ, our blog, regional newsletters (EN/DE). Draft embargo email will be posted after Legal OK.
Emma: Owners & dates: Luis (partner assets + SKU) 05/30, Tanya (runbook + creds) 06/12, Legal (sign-off) 06/03, Comms (embargo send) 06/21.
Luis: Noted. Contingency: if NebulaEdge misses assets, we launch Redwood marketplace tile Jun 22 and do a partner highlight later.
Emma: Great. Please react with :white_check_mark: once you've confirmed your deliverable dates. Closing after confirmations.
